newsitem.title: USA: Schmitt says Oct. sales set record.
newsitem.headline: Schmitt says Oct. sales set record.

text.p: PORTLAND, Ore., Nov. 4 (Reuter) Schmitt Industries Inc said on Monday its October sales reached a record near $1.03 million, a 115-percent increase from October 1995's $475,359.
In the first five months of Schmitt's current fiscal year, sales including balancers and measurement equipment were $3.5 million, a 57-percent increase from last year's $2.2 million.
Management expects trends in increased sales and profits to continue through the fiscal year ending May 31, 1997.
Sales for all products, both SBS Dynamic Balancers and SMS Laser Based Measurement Products, increased across the board, and new customers were established for Measurement Products.
